assumptions: The model explicitly supplies state, input, answer projection, deterministic transition, and admitted-input predicate.
claims.statement: A transition profile packages state, input, answer, observation, transition, and aperture components.
claims.ceiling: Model schema only; it defines no physical or PAL primitive.
claims.residual: Source authentication, restore guards, resources, authority, and realization adequacy remain external assumptions.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run
assumptions: Transitions are deterministic function application in the declared profile.
claims.statement: run applies a finite list of inputs from left to right.
claims.ceiling: Defines an abstract finite evaluator only.
claims.residual: It does not establish execution, persistence, fairness, or runtime resource sufficiency.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.admissibleSuffix
assumptions: Membership in the declared input predicate is the full aperture test in this model.
claims.statement: An admissible finite suffix contains only inputs accepted by the profile aperture.
claims.residual: No claim that the aperture matches an external task or actual permitted continuations.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.oneSuffixEquivalent
assumptions: Answer observations and the exact suffix are specified by the profile and caller.
claims.statement: OneSuffixEquivalent states equality of answers after one particular suffix.
claims.residual: Does not imply all-suffix continuation equivalence.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.continuationEquivalent
assumptions: Universal quantification is over finite suffixes satisfying this profile's declared aperture.
claims.statement: ContinuationEquivalent universally quantifies observation equality over every admitted finite suffix.
claims.ceiling: All finite suffixes in the encoded aperture only.
claims.residual: Infinite continuations, outside-aperture inputs, scheduler behavior, and source validity remain unclaimed.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.run_append
claims.statement: Executing concatenated finite suffixes is equal to executing the first suffix and then the second.
claims.residual: Does not prove any freeze/restore operation preserves state or that an input suffix is permitted.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.one_suffix_of_step_simulation
source_routes: PAL v2.4 candidate Mathematical Realization Atlas M-CONTINUATION-PROFILE
assumptions: Initial states satisfy a supplied relation.
The supplied relation is preserved for each admitted input.
The suffix is finite and every member is admitted.
claims.statement: A step-preserving simulation relation yields equal observations after one specified admitted finite suffix.
claims.ceiling: Conditional theorem over arbitrary declared types/functions; no claim that a concrete restore satisfies the relation hypotheses.
claims.residual: Model-to-source adequacy and the validity of a selected initial relation are not established.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.all_finite_suffixes_of_step_simulation
assumptions: Initial states satisfy a supplied relation.
The supplied relation is preserved for each admitted input.
claims.statement: The step-simulation hypotheses establish equal observations for every finite suffix admitted by the declared profile.
claims.ceiling: Universal only within the encoded finite suffix domain and supplied aperture.
claims.residual: Does not extend to infinite or unmodeled inputs, nor establish that the aperture is externally complete.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.narrowAperture
assumptions: Only Boolean inputs are modeled; false is the initial aperture.
claims.statement: The narrow profile accepts only false inputs.
claims.residual: The aperture is illustrative and is not asserted to be an external permission policy.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.apertureStep
assumptions: State is Nat × Bool; the Boolean component acts as a retained transition condition.
claims.statement: The state count increases only when both the input and retained condition are true.
claims.residual: No account authority or semantic meaning is assigned to fixture coordinates.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.narrowProfile
assumptions: Observation is the Nat projection; only false is admitted.
claims.statement: A narrow-aperture profile using apertureStep and the Nat observation.
claims.residual: No general profile adequacy is asserted.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.wideProfile
assumptions: Observation and transition match narrowProfile; every Boolean input is admitted.
claims.statement: A widened-aperture profile that adds true while retaining the same transition and observation.
claims.residual: No general profile adequacy is asserted.

claims.name: Experiments.Pal24Continuation.aperture_expansion_distinguishes_future
assumptions: Concrete Nat × Bool states and apertureStep as defined in this module.
claims.statement: The fixture states have equal selected Nat answers and unequal full states; they agree on every narrow-aperture finite suffix and on the selected wide suffix [false], while the newly admitted wide suffix [true] distinguishes their future answers.
claims.ceiling: Counterexample to inferring exact state recovery or all-continuation equivalence from current-answer or single-suffix agreement in this finite fixture.
claims.residual: The fixture is not evidence about full PAL, full MIND, cognition, physical storage, source authenticity, authority, or any domain outside its encoded profiles.
